title: rosa × dumetorum var. semiglabra
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. semiglabra, commonly known as the scented rose or Rosa semiglabra, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum var. semiglabra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The flavonoids present in this plant have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, while the essential oils have a calming effect on the nervous system.
